page.layout: Title block at top: three centred lines (I N D E / PARTIS / Ord...), then one column of index entries with page numbers at the right of each entry.; Top: the end of a title, one block across the full width. Below it, two columns of index entries, the left column with its letter initial "B", the right column with its large initial "C". Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: I N D E PARTIS Ord[?]
X PRIORIS HVIVS OPERIS, ine alphabetico digestus.

page.notes: The right edge of the entries is cut off, so several lines end before their full wording. The entry "Antigonus Alexandri" is continued beyond the visible part. Doubtful readings: Accia, Ach.lles, Anthermus, and the final page number 139. The title at the top is only its end; the opening words are not on this part of the page. The large letter "B" stands alone above the entry "Aasa", and the large "C" is set as the initial of "Admus". The entry "Aasa" is printed beside the "B" and may be read as "Baasa" or part of a longer word; it is copied as printed. The left edge of the entries is cut in this part of the scan, so the words are given from their visible letters only.
